scope_fields.topology: Uniform, equivalently compact-open; explicitly an interpretation because the short source statements leave mapping-space topology unstated.
accepted_claims: Every extension fiber is a contractible finite-PL homeomorphism group via the Alexander rescaling formula.
The fiber interpolation is continuous even when the common target Jordan region varies.
Local PL-valued sections everywhere globalize by locally finite, finite-at-each-input weighted interpolation; zero weights and support boundaries are valid without local compactness.
Global section existence is equivalent to section existence on a full uniform neighborhood of the inclusion; ambient PL Schoenflies matches the full boundary parametrization.
The convex-image subspace has the claimed 1-Lipschitz finite-PL selector.
For every continuous radial-cone apex rule near the inclusion, an appropriate shrinking hairpin family obstructs injectivity.
Any exact extension selector requires unbounded triangulation complexity on every full uniform neighborhood.
